title: standup configuration
description: Configuration for standup — Jira + GitHub sprint dashboard. ${VAR} references are expanded from the environment.

refresh.description: Background auto-refresh interval for the active client, as a Go duration ("30s", "2m") or "off". Default 30s; values under 10s are clamped.

refresh_minutes.description: Older integer form of refresh (minutes); negative disables. Prefer `refresh`.

icons.description: Marker glyph set. "nerd" (default) needs a Nerd Font such as JetBrainsMono Nerd Font; "ascii" uses plain-unicode fallbacks.

link_pattern.description: Regex extracting issue keys from PR titles and branch names for issue⇄PR linking. Default: [A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-\d+

hide_clients.description: Show only the active client in the header; other client names never render (switch with number keys or the `w` picker). For full isolation run `standup <client>`.

agent.description: AI coding agent for the `a` key: "claude" (default), "copilot", or any command line; {prompt} is replaced with the issue context (appended if absent).

git_ui.description: Git TUI for the `L` key. Default: lazygit.

chat_permission_mode.description: claude --permission-mode for the in-app chat (A key). Default acceptEdits: file edits auto-approved, other actions follow your Claude settings allowlists. Use plan for read-only chat.

name.description: Tab name; also the default local clones folder (~/projects/<name>) and the argument for `standup <name>`.

projects_dir.description: Directory holding this client's local git clones. Default: ~/projects/<name>. Used by checkout/lazygit/terminal/agent actions and branch markers.

base_url.description: Jira site URL, e.g. https://yoursite.atlassian.net or a self-hosted https://jira.example.com.

flavor.description: "cloud" (email + API token, REST v3) or "datacenter"/"server" (PAT bearer auth, REST v2). Defaults to cloud when email is set, datacenter otherwise.

email.description: Account email (Jira Cloud basic auth). Omit for Data Center PAT auth.

token.description: Literal API token / PAT. Prefer token_env.

token_env.description: Name of the environment variable holding the API token / PAT.

projects.description: Comma-separated project keys to limit the query to, e.g. "PROJ,OTHER".

jql.description: Full replacement for the default query (assignee = currentUser() AND sprint in openSprints()). Use for Kanban or custom boards.

host.description: GitHub host. Default github.com; set for GitHub Enterprise.

token.description: Literal token. Prefer token_env or a gh CLI login.

token_env.description: Name of the environment variable holding the token. When absent, the token comes from `gh auth token`.

repos.description: Limit searches to these owner/repo entries.

repo_map.description: Jira project key → default repo folder for the chat when an item has no linked PR/branch yet, e.g. {FALCON: zpc-system-test}.

env.description: Extra environment for every subprocess standup launches for this client (chat, agent, terminal, git UI). Values support a leading ~/. Example: {CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR: ~/.claude-zebra} for a per-client Claude profile.

chat_allowed_tools.description: Tools pre-approved for the headless chat via --allowedTools (headless runs cannot show permission prompts). E.g. mcp__jira__add_comment, Bash(gh pr view *).

keys.description: Remap shortcuts by action id (press ? in the app to see them). Ids: down, up, top, bottom, view-toggle, view-issues, view-prs, client-picker, detail, detail-alt, expand, collapse, toggle, groups-all, git-view, jump, checkout, git-ui, terminal, agent, copy, copy-linked, open, refresh, filter, edit-config, back, to-list, help, quit.

auto_update.description: Silently update direct-binary installs in the background when a new release exists (sha256-verified; applies on next launch). Brew and go-install builds only get a notice. Default true.

branch_template.description: Branch name for the b start-work flow; {key} is the issue key. Default "{key}".

alerts.description: Policy-alert thresholds in days. 0/omitted → defaults; negative disables that alert.

approved_days.description: Flag PRs approved but unmerged for more than N days (default 3; negative disables).

stale_review_days.description: Flag open non-draft PRs with no activity for more than N days (default 5; negative disables).
